eg3113_ds.note: Chinese only: EGmicro publishes no English EG3113 datasheet (its product page lists two documents, both Chinese). 12 PDF pages: cover, revision table and contents (PDF pp.1-3), then the body printed '1/1' (a footer slip, PDF p.4) and '2/9' to '9/9' (PDF pp.5-12). Locators below give the PDF page and the printed one, e.g. 'PDF p.8 (5/9)'. The text layer is good Chinese (pdftotext gets every character), but the feature bullets are a private-use glyph, the overbar on LIN does not extract, and table cells break across lines in -layout mode, so table quotes give a row's cells in order. tools/library_quotes.py keeps Chinese characters (norm() was extended for this package). The document contradicts itself in places, recorded in rules.json: the input-high threshold is 3 V minimum in the table (PDF p.8) but '2.5V 以上' in §8.2 (PDF p.10); quiescent current is 'less than 5uA' in the features (PDF p.4) but 50 uA maximum in the table (PDF p.8); the truth table (PDF p.11) labels HIN 'pin 4' (it is pin 2). LCSC's datasheet for C480666 is an older build of the same V1.2 (PDF created 2019-11-18, sha256 70df0bd34bcfab4b8db07ed1824af7564b34bea0652283539fe01693a02e483b, 504710 bytes) whose table gives Vin(H) 2.5 V min, Icc 30 uA max and Iin 20 uA; it was read for comparison and is not cited. The vendor's other document, 'EG3113 MOS驱动芯片数据手册V1.1.pdf' (sha256 3add1fc8…), is the superseded V1.1 and was not used.

bsc030n08ns5_ds.title: BSC030N08NS5 OptiMOS 5 Power-Transistor, 80 V
bsc030n08ns5_ds.doc: BSC030N08NS5 Final Data Sheet (as linked by LCSC for C501507)
bsc030n08ns5_ds.note: The MOSFET the reference board fits as AH1/AL1 (LCSC C501507; rev A's schematic values it 'MOSFETSO-8', the board's later schematic names it BSC030N08NS5). 13 pages; the printed page number in each footer equals the PDF page. Read for the gate drive and bootstrap: VGS(th), RDS(on) test voltages, Qg and the plateau (Tables 4 and 6, p.4). The text layer drops the spaces in headings and features ('Gatechargecharacteristics') and separates numbers from units in the test conditions with a control character ('VGS=6V'), which the quote check reads as a space; quotes are table rows. Infineon's own site was not tried; LCSC's copy is Infineon's Rev. 2.3 file as published.
